summary: We will want to make the argument that it is the "space" of learning and not the individual that should be the variable of interest if we want to have the largest gains in knowledge growth and that the best spaces rely on agentive apprenticeships toward common goals.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: We will want to make the argument that it is the "space" of learning and not the individual that should be the variable of interest if we want to have the largest gains in knowledge growth and that the best spaces rely on agentive apprenticeships toward common goals.
